rules.title: Lead (Pb) content must not exceed 0.1% by weight
rules.description: EU RoHS restricts lead in homogeneous materials to 1000 ppm (0.1%). Components above this threshold cannot be placed on the EU market without an exemption.

rules.title: Mercury (Hg) content must not exceed 0.1% by weight
rules.description: EU RoHS restricts mercury in homogeneous materials to 0.1%.

rules.title: Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) declaration required
rules.description: REACH requires a manufacturer declaration when SVHC-listed substances are present above 0.1%. A declaration on file is required for every component sold into the EU.

rules.title: Conflict minerals (3TG) due-diligence declaration required
rules.description: Components containing tin, tantalum, tungsten, or gold (3TG) require a due-diligence declaration filed with the SEC. Applies to electrical and electronic components.
